audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] through whys[6] are shifted one stage early: whys[3] (the Levels 4-5 slot) describes his level-6 Maiden, whys[4] (Level 6) describes his first sustain item, and so on. The level chart itself says Jayce owns Level 6, while the same page's prose says the lane flips to Yorick there.
audit.why: The seven whys map to Level 1, 2, 3, 4-5, 6, first item, 2+ items. Eulogy of the Isles is a level-6 ability, so the Maiden line belongs in slot 4, not slot 3. Jayce is 47.78% into Yorick over 1329 games, which is consistent with the prose (Yorick takes over from 6) and not with the chart.

audit.why: Spikes at 2-3, 6 (Eulogy of the Isles, 160s at rank 1), first item and late are correctly placed; level 6 is genuinely his and the page says so.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mourning Mist is described only as a slow that rushes ghouls, and Last Rites only as a heal. Both descriptions omit the part that actually decides the trade.
audit.why: Riot's text: Mourning Mist 'reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies' — it is an armour shred, so his follow-up hits harder than the page implies. Last Rites deals bonus damage on his NEXT ATTACK and heals him, i.e. it is an auto-attack reset: the tell is the wind-up, not the cast, and Grievous Wounds is what blunts it.
audit.corrected: Name the armour shred on Mourning Mist and the reset-plus-heal on Last Rites.
